_: The utility apps the shell (public/app/shell.js) draws; index.html is its Home (N18). Shape: docs/DESIGN-NOTES-2026-10.md Part 2.4. state built = route is a utility page; workshop = it exists only inside the workshop, so no route and a dashed chip (FIT Q3, I12); coming = not built. facts = an /api URL the shell GETs, answering { lines: [ 'text' | { text, tone:'dn' } ] } (at most two lines); null = no such read exists yet, so the card shows no figure (never an invented one) — the reads each card needs are listed in the N18 PR. rail = the Home widget: facts answers { suppliers, customers, in, out, stuck } (digits); route = where Open goes; null = not drawn. Every facts URL needs its line in the API's round-trips.budget.json (I19). pillar = the box an entry stands under on Home (Selling): marketing · sales · finance · accounting (the main row) · operations · people · trade (the supporting row) · labs · setup; an entry has ONE pillar, so a card shows once; a missing pillar falls back to its area. area stays the roadmap's grouping. No 'tier' (Q5). OPTIONAL per entry, read by the Sign-in Lab Roadmap tab (public/signin-lab.html; never by the shell): rows = plan ids from MASTER-BUILD-2026-10.md (e.g. M30, R06; [] or absent = no row yet) · phase = its phase in that plan, as one short string (e.g. P3 books + payments) · fits = one short line on how it connects to the rail. works = true on a workshop row whose function works today (Connectors: Tally + Zoho): the Roadmap tab says built while the shell still draws it as workshop. Plan ids are never printed on the page; the Roadmap tab prints them nowhere but the manifest. The Sign-in Lab Roadmap tab is drawn from these rows only. word = an entry whose name is the shop's COUNTRY word of that kind (helpers.js packWord; NAMES-1: stock = Inventory for a US shop, Stock elsewhere): name is the neutral word, painted until the shop's country is known.
editions_: AX1 (2026-10-13): an EDITION is which entries a showing draws — ONE map here, never a flag per entry, so a showing is read and changed in one place. key → { name (the avatar menu's word), chip (the header chip; absent on full), line (one line on Home saying what the view is for), entries: '*' | [ids] }. An id with no entry yet draws nothing (compare = the parallel-run compare, listed now, drawn when PR1 adds its entry). Read by public/app/edition.js (CBEdition) only. An edition HIDES, it never grants: the server still decides access.

auditor.name: Auditor view
auditor.line: For your auditor: the books, what is owed, the standards and the papers. Nothing here runs the shop.

entries.name: Marketing
entries.what: Reach customers and bring them back.
entries.fits: Customer groups, offer consent and the shop window, over the same parties.

entries.name: Finance
entries.what: Who owes you, who you owe, and when.
entries.fits: Finance: payment advice and reminders over the same chits.

entries.name: Operations
entries.what: Stock and suppliers.
entries.fits: Operations: stock from every receipt and sale, and the suppliers you order from.

entries.name: Stock
entries.what: How much of each you have.
entries.fits: Counts follow the chits that move goods.

entries.name: Tasks & Orders
entries.what: Every order and task, and who has each line.
entries.fits: Orders in and out, tasks, each line's state and holder — the workflow engine's verdicts, painted.

entries.name: Suppliers
entries.what: Who you buy from.
entries.fits: Your suppliers, as the rail lists them.

entries.name: Counters
entries.what: Counters, and the keys systems use.
entries.fits: Which counters may sell for your shop.

entries.name: Employees
entries.what: Your people, and what each can do.
entries.fits: People and access, inside the same sign-in.

entries.name: Delivery
entries.fits: Delivery steps are lines on the same chit.

entries.name: Till
entries.what: Take money at the counter.
entries.fits: Takes the money; every bill goes onto the rail as a chit.

entries.name: Your online shop
entries.what: Your shop on the web.
entries.fits: Orders from the web land on the rail like any other chit.

entries.name: Catalogue
entries.what: What you sell, one list.
entries.fits: The one list of what you sell; chits and offers read it.

entries.name: Accounts
entries.what: What the shop made, and what it owes.
entries.fits: Posts the one frozen invoice both sides hold.

entries.name: Parallel run
entries.what: Their books beside ours, every difference explained.
entries.fits: Their Tally or Xero period, read as a snapshot; ours from the rail.

entries.name: Bank
entries.what: Your bank statement against your books.
entries.fits: The statement's carried figures (the Bank page signs them); the card reads them, never a second sum.

entries.name: CRM
entries.what: Who buys, and how often.
entries.fits: Fills each party record from the chits you share.

entries.name: Know your business
entries.what: What we know about your business, and how far to trust it.
entries.fits: Checks a business before the first chit.

entries.name: Documents
entries.what: Forms for an authority.
entries.fits: Forms for an authority, filled from the chit.

entries.name: Consent & privacy
entries.what: Who agreed, and privacy requests.
entries.fits: Consent per channel on the party record; requests answered on the law's clock.

entries.name: Network
entries.what: Who is in your network, and what it offers you.
entries.fits: The map of who you trade with on the rail.

entries.name: Disputes
entries.what: What you raised, what is against you, and how each ended.
entries.fits: A dispute is a thread on the chit both sides see.

entries.name: Assist
entries.what: Drafts an answer; you accept it.
entries.fits: Helps fill and check a chit; you confirm.

entries.name: Product Lab
entries.what: Work out the price of each item and what it leaves you.
entries.fits: Try an item list before it reaches the catalogue.

entries.name: Offer Lab
entries.what: Discounts, and whether they clear your margin.
entries.fits: Try an offer on a sample bill.

entries.name: Combo Lab
entries.what: Two at one price.
entries.fits: Try a bundle price on a sample bill.

entries.name: Network Lab
entries.what: Sketch a network and see what would break.
entries.fits: Try a network on paper before anything is made.

entries.name: Country Lab
entries.what: Tax, rounding and rules of a country, tried on a sample bill.
entries.fits: Try a country's tax and rounding on a sample bill.

entries.name: Conversion Lab
entries.what: Change units and money, and see the sums.
entries.fits: Try a unit or currency change on a sample bill.

entries.name: Dispute Lab
entries.what: Raise a sample dispute and watch both sides.
entries.fits: Send a sample chit and watch both sides.

entries.name: Standards
entries.what: What a chit must contain.
entries.fits: The rules the rail follows, each with an example.

entries.name: Your business
entries.what: Your details, on every bill.
entries.fits: Your shop details, used on every chit; the country its books follow.

entries.name: Connectors
entries.what: Tally, Zoho or files, both ways.
entries.fits: Tally and Zoho both ways: download the kit, approve the PC.

entries.name: Compatibility Lab
entries.what: How we compare, and what works with us.
entries.fits: The Standards page's Compared with tab: your country's packages, each claim sourced (STD-COMPARE).

entries.name: Coverage
entries.what: Test coverage, stable state and bug hunt (development only).
entries.fits: Where the tests stand while we hunt bugs.

entries.name: Policy
entries.what: Your shop's rules, and who may change each.
entries.fits: The rules saved on your business; the server says who may change each.

entries.name: Account
entries.what: Sign-ins, keys and papers.
entries.fits: Your sign-ins, the keys other systems use, the vault that fills every form.

entries.name: Reports
entries.what: Your chits measured: open, stuck, how old.
entries.fits: The rail measured once on the server; every number opens the chits it counts.

entries.name: Trend
entries.what: Sales beside last year, week to year.
entries.fits: Summary chits the counters send, folded once on the server; a short period says so.

entries.name: Plan & usage
entries.what: Your plan, and what was used.
entries.fits: What your plan includes, and what was billed.
